purpose: Resume full-device discovery without rescanning or modifying the completed current-Mac baseline.
required_user_action: Provide and unlock the next actual device, then keep it available while the read-only inventory is frozen.
intake_fields: directories or accounts explicitly excluded by the user
execution_order: freeze read-only local and browser inventories
deduplicate accounts already captured on the current Mac
reconcile scanned equals included plus excluded plus blocked
route strong signals to evidence capture and weak signals to review
sync versioned indexes after checksum verification
preservation_guarantees: No original file, bookmark, platform collection, or browser database will be moved, deleted, or edited.
An inaccessible device or account remains blocked and is never reported as complete.
Duplicate content retains every source context and is linked rather than deleted.
